case: Concurso ordinario 36/2012 — Luchy Playa Blanca, S.L.U. — Juzgado de lo Mercantil n.º 1 de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria
status: PUBLIC EVIDENCE-LED ANALYTICAL MATRIX — NOT A CERTIFIED COURT DOCKET
publication_rules: A filing proves that a position or request was made; it does not prove the truth of every allegation in it.
No responsive order located in the reviewed corpus means a verification gap; it does not prove that no order exists.
A judicial or LAJ act is reported according to its operative effect and limits; it is not expanded into authority it does not contain.
LPB is the debtor. The concurso does not by itself confer title, possession, exploitation or works authority over Matkator or other third-party property.

Loss, destruction, diversion, overreach, omission, facilitation and causation are described as pleaded or analytical propositions unless established by a primary decision or other identified primary record.
Adverse procedural treatment is kept separate from an adjudication on the merits.

boundary.inside_concurso: LPB patrimony, LPB rights and claims, and acts lawfully falling within Concurso 36/2012
boundary.outside_or_requires_separate_authority: Matkator property and rights, other owners' property and rights, and any whole-hotel control, access, operation, works, income or disposal not grounded in specific title, consent or competent order

tracks.documented_court_effect: Voluntary concurso of LPB; LPB powers retained subject to insolvency-administrator intervention at opening; updated inventory ordered.
tracks.limit: The opening order is not a title, disposition or possession order over third-party property.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Any later use of the concurso as a whole-hotel authority must be tested against the LPB-only perimeter and against each asset/right actually belonging to LPB.

tracks.documented_court_effect: Liquidation opened; LPB powers over its patrimony suspended; LPB dissolved; insolvency administrator substituted; liquidation plan and reports required.
tracks.limit: The order concerns LPB patrimony. It is not a general conveyance or third-party-property mechanism.
tracks.position_or_consequence: This is the principal boundary against treating the limited LPB concurso as control over the whole mixed-title hotel.

tracks.documented_court_effect: The plan proposed LPB liquidation routes; the approval authorised the enumerated LPB-finca routes and expressly excluded property of others.
tracks.limit: Approval was not self-executing whole-hotel authority and remained subject to publicity, competition, conveyance, accounting and the order's stated asset perimeter.
tracks.position_or_consequence: The express third-party-property exclusion is central to the alleged overreach analysis.

tracks.documented_court_effect: Clarified competitive debt components, working-day period, deposit timing, no remate assignment and court-run licitation.
tracks.limit: Not a conveyance, closing ledger or authority for access, security, possession, works or hotel operation.
tracks.position_or_consequence: The order should not be used as a substitute source of authority for the physical-control events three days later.

tracks.issue: Material takeover / change of control at Sun Park
tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The controlled chronology identifies a material access/control episode involving locks, security, exclusion and practical control allegations at Sun Park.
tracks.court_treatment_status: NO SPECIFIC RESPONSIVE OR AUTHORISING ORDER FOR THE 7-JUNE PHYSICAL CONTROL EPISODE IS IDENTIFIED IN THE CURRENT CANONICAL RECORD
tracks.limit: This is an evidence-gap statement, not proof that no responsive act exists. The authority must be reconstructed actor-by-actor and asset-by-asset.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Core questions: who ordered access/security/locks; what was the legal basis; what LPB assets were affected; what Matkator/third-party assets were affected; what income, records, equipment and operational capacity changed hands; what did the court and insolvency administrator know and when.

tracks.documented_court_effect: Suspended only realisation of listed mortgaged apartment fincas; other liquidation continued.
tracks.limit: The controlled record expressly identifies no possession, works, exploitation, income or keys authority in this order.
tracks.position_or_consequence: The order cannot by itself cure or authorise the earlier 7-June physical-control episode.

tracks.issue: Funded exit, operation and value-preservation route
tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The controlled chronology identifies Stoneweg/Aweswell financing and Daniel Irigoyen/ONA communications on 12–13 June 2018, followed by September–November efforts seeking debt quantification, funded conclusion and hotel operation.
tracks.court_treatment_status: EXACT COURT RECEIPT, PROCEDURAL TREATMENT AND RESPONSIVE-ORDER CHAIN REMAIN TO BE CLOSED
tracks.limit: The present corpus supports publication of the request/chronology and the gap; it does not support a categorical finding that a particular filing was ignored without its filing receipt and the certified docket.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Relevant to pleaded loss of rescue opportunity, closure/non-operation, active-estate value, productive-unit continuity and causation.

tracks.issue: Locales/pools sale implementation and later judicial correction
tracks.documented_or_reported_event: A 28 November 2018 deed purported to sell 31 fincas for EUR400,000 before the 12 December LAJ direction to formalise the sale; the canonical record reports that the 12 December direction was later set aside by an order of 24 October 2019.
tracks.court_treatment_status: CONTROLLED IMPLEMENTATION ANOMALY; COMPLETE CASH, TITLE, RESTITUTION AND ACCOUNTING CHAIN STILL OPEN
tracks.limit: The deed and later procedural acts must not be collapsed into a single lawful-authority inference.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Relevant to estate accounting, implementation control, restitution and the wider active-estate harm analysis.
tracks.evidence_status: PRIMARY DOCUMENTS CONTROLLED / DOWNSTREAM CHAIN OPEN

tracks.issue: Economic/forensic evidence placed before the court
tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The controlled chronology records LPB/Gil opposition filings in Section Six invoking or attaching David Espejo reports and requesting testigo-perito evidence; David Espejo was later formally cited in 2022.
tracks.court_treatment_status: EVIDENCE ROUTE DOCUMENTED; COMPLETE RULING-BY-RULING TREATMENT OF EVERY PROPOSITION REMAINS OPEN
tracks.limit: Later citation of the expert witness does not establish acceptance of every report conclusion.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Relevant to what economic/value issues were placed before the court and when.

tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The controlled record identifies adjudication, title/cancellation and accounting families but retains material gaps concerning final compensable debt, surplus, implementation, all-finca registry effect and final estate accounting.
tracks.court_treatment_status: PARTIAL — PRIMARY DECISIONS EXIST; IMPLEMENTATION/ACCOUNTING DENOMINATOR NOT CLOSED
tracks.limit: Adjudication of LPB property does not by itself establish title or authority over third-party assets or the whole hotel business.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Relevant to alleged displacement of value, recoveries, fruits and the boundary between LPB's estate and extraconcursal rights.

tracks.issue: Removal of insolvency administrator and fee challenges
tracks.documented_court_effect: The located first-instance removal and fee routes were dismissed on standing/legitimacy grounds; the public specialist corpus states that the merits of the seven removal grounds and the material legality/quantum of the fees were not decided by those first-instance rulings.
tracks.court_treatment_status: ADVERSE PROCEDURAL OUTCOME; MERITS NOT ADJUDICATED IN THE IDENTIFIED FIRST-INSTANCE RULINGS
tracks.limit: Pending/live appeals must not be described as decided unless a signed outcome is obtained.
tracks.position_or_consequence: The page should show the distinction between an adverse procedural ruling and an adverse merits ruling.
tracks.evidence_status: PRIMARY SPECIALIST CORPUS CONTROLLED / AP OUTCOMES OPEN

tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The recovery corpus separates LPB estate claims including units/rights, fruits, occupation, deterioration, credits, overpayment, lost insolvency opportunity and insolvency-administrator responsibility.
tracks.court_treatment_status: NOT PRESENTED HERE AS AN ADJUDICATED GLOBAL FINDING
tracks.limit: Each loss requires asset ownership, period, actor, causation, quantum and remedy proof.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Public formulation: alleged cumulative diminution/destruction of the masa activa and recoverable value, to be proved item-by-item.

tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The controlled recovery analysis separately identifies operator/business components such as income, reservations/data, contracts, goodwill, operating capacity and the need to determine their holder.
tracks.court_treatment_status: NOT PRESENTED HERE AS AN ADJUDICATED GLOBAL FINDING
tracks.limit: The productive unit is not identical to LPB's real-estate inventory; ownership and control of each business component must be established.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Public formulation: alleged destruction/disruption of productive-unit continuity, including closure/non-operation, lost operating income, opportunity and business value, subject to proof of holder and causation.

tracks.documented_or_reported_event: The recovery analysis treats Matkator property and direct damage as extraconcursal and requires separate title/authority. The wider group position alleges patrimonial harm both within and outside Concurso 36/2012.
tracks.court_treatment_status: BOUNDARY QUESTION REQUIRING ASSET-BY-ASSET AND RIGHT-BY-RIGHT RECONSTRUCTION
tracks.limit: The concurso cannot itself substitute for Matkator consent/title or automatically absorb separate owners, business rights or direct losses.
tracks.position_or_consequence: Overreach test: for each act ask (1) whose asset/right, (2) what title/authority, (3) what court order if any, (4) who acted/benefited, (5) what notice/objection was filed, (6) what response was made, and (7) what loss followed.

gap_closure: Obtain a signed electronic chronological index or equivalent certified per-piece export for every section/incident of Concurso 36/2012.
For every located party filing, bind filing receipt, annex list, service, court/LAJ response, appeal, finality and implementation into one record family.

Close the exact 7-June-2018 authority chain: Community minutes/audio/proxies, AC communications, security/locksmith instructions, access logs, police/notarial records, keys, inventory, photographs and contemporaneous court filings.
Close the 12–13 June 2018 Stoneweg/ONA funded-exit court receipt and treatment chain, including any meeting note, filing, transfer, order, minute or silence interval capable of being proved.

Reconcile the complete masa-activa ledger: opening inventory, liquidation-plan inventory, quarterly reports, bank accounts, recoveries, fruits/income, EUR400,000 route, adjudication credit, surplus, final accounts and conclusion.

Reconstruct the productive-unit ledger separately from real-estate title: operator, reservations, revenue, contracts, staff, licences, utilities, data, goodwill, closure/reopening and post-takeover commercial exploitation.
Maintain a third-party/extraconcursal ledger for Matkator and every non-LPB finca/right so no concursal act is treated as authority beyond its proven perimeter.
Obtain signed merits outcomes and service/finality for live AP rolls, including the removal/fees appeals and RPL 2523/2025 when available.
Never upgrade 'not located' to 'did not exist' without certified docket evidence.
